The prospective planar opaque/unlit GPU color gate now passes for AdaptiveAffineOpaque and AffineMidpointOpaque on exact JavaFX 24.0.1 macOS ES2 with the no-mip/centroid compatibility module. Renderer implementation is unchanged from adaptive-22. Added native JavaFxAffineColorProbe and tools/surface-view/javafx-affine-color/{oracle.py,check-oracle.py,plan.json,README.md}. Protocol SHA256 66cf5d0e708914708c7a287bb87b30a27514897e85581ba7e72b339072b82a37 was fixed before native results.

For each encoding: 48 fixtures cover diagonal/RGB triangles, 2,048/32,768-face ramps, front/oblique planes, cyclic/shuffled face orders and AA off/on. All 1,838,544 pixel instances pass, including 732,618 internal-edge instances; all 32 permutation checks pass. Worst conservative pixel-footprint excess is 1.223 channel levels; worst AA-off center error 1.452; maximum order/packing difference 1. The frozen integration budget is 2 levels. The oracle uses only original colored triangle/pixel intersections; closed-form fields independently verify its reference within 5.685e-14. No atlas, native UV or midpoint-table reuse.

Prespecified controls fail correctly: patched legacy encoding passes only 24/48 cases, reaches 21.483 center error and 21 levels of order dependence; stock JavaFX with adaptive encoding passes only 36/48, reaches 17.625 footprint excess and 18 levels of packing dependence. Root viewed the positive/negative edge and ramp pairs. Oracle CLI exits 1 on these failures, not merely reports success for generating images. Cache identity includes original binary, oracle source and NumPy version.

The affected native JVM suite passes 38 tests under exact Intaglio 55658abf override. Initial native test compile caught an undeclared Swing export dependency; final probe uses JDK image export and adds no dependency. Actual sbt-compiled probe reproduces all initial 192 PNGs AND their original-input binaries byte for byte. Native antialiasing changes are visible in 42/48 positive fixture pairs, including the saturated oblique case. Sources, failed compile, final tests, render/oracle commands, input/runtime hashes, all images/binaries and reports are retained in consumer output/brain-display/gpu-color-23 (854 files; verified manifest).

Scope is planar, unlit, opaque, parallel-camera pixels, maxTextureSize=256. Bounds are conservative for MSAA interpolation/mixtures; partial OUTER silhouette/background pixels are excluded, internal edges retained. This is not exact multisample-location parity or full cortical acceptance. Large production atlas precision, cortical occlusion/edge behavior, lighting, perspective, actual device scaling, ray picks, Prism heap admission and runtime packaging remain. No native commit, consumer dependency or installed runtime adoption. Keep the broader issue open; native default Intaglio pin mismatch also remains separate.
